reasons: Selector uses otel_metric_type="gauge" but postgresql.tup_updated is defined as a monotonic sum and the dataset only has dataset_types [sum], so the query would match no series.
rate() is applied to a monotonic sum, which is allowed, and the per-second rate fits the widget title, so the quantity and unit are plausible once the type is fixed.
Datadog avg with no grouping maps to avg() with no by-clause, so aggregation and grouping are consistent.
Scope template variable has no prefix and default *, so dropping it is correct.
Outcome translated is appropriate because the metric exists in the dataset and a direct mapping exists; the fix is changing otel_metric_type to sum.
